name: Kai Cenat GTA 6 Marathon
creator: Kai Cenat
search_queries: Kai Cenat GTA 6 marathon full stream
content_rules: Footage must be from the qualifying GTA 6 Marathon, beginning November 18, 2026.
Kai Cenat must be the main focus of the clip.
Kai must be shown playing GTA 6 in the clip.
No fake engagement (bought views, likes, comments, bots).
No misleading narratives (do not invent context, beef or events that did not happen).
No added logos / watermarks of other brands or clipping tools.
Do not repost existing Kai Cenat Shorts - clips must be cut from original stream footage.

per_moment_checks.kai_main_focus: Is Kai Cenat clearly the main focus (face cam / voice dominant)?
per_moment_checks.playing_gta6: Is Kai visibly playing GTA 6 in this moment (gameplay on screen)?
per_moment_checks.no_third_party_logos: Is the clip free of third-party logos/watermarks that would remain after editing?
per_moment_checks.not_existing_short: Was no identical existing Kai Cenat Short found in competition research?

audience_rules: At least 50% of the audience must come from USA, Canada, UK, Australia and New Zealand. This depends on the posting account - check your account analytics before posting; the skill cannot verify it.
notes: Rules were supplied by the user. Re-read the official campaign brief before posting in case they changed.
